svg.title: CRM Dashboard — Tablet 768
svg.desc: Editable SVG export of the Pipeline CRM practice prototype (AI-assisted, not an assessment submission). Supplied metrics exact; opportunity records are illustrative demo data.

g.text: Team-wide. Achieved revenue is actual; everything else is pipeline.
Pipeline, weighted and potential values are not guaranteed revenue and are not forecasts.
Stage-wise aggregates were not supplied. Values are derived from the demo records in view.
Not the real distribution of the 142 open opportunities
Highest priority first. Select a record to review and act.
